info.title: mojo API
info.description: Backend API for mojo: Japanese learning with SRS, AI-rated practice and gamification.

post.description: Ends this device's session. Idempotent: succeeds even if already signed out.

get.description: XP per day over the last week and XP per skill, both from the activity log.

post.description: Saves the answers and marks the user onboarded. Submitting again updates the answers.

get.description: The lesson plus what it contains, so the client knows which practices to offer.
Cards due now. New cards enter the schedule the first time they are reviewed.

post.description: Rates each transcript against the scripted line; the expected text always comes from the dialogue.
Per-line feedback while practising; earns no XP.
The next line of a free conversation with the AI partner.
Rates the drawing against the practice's kanji (taken from the database, never from the client).

AccessTokenData.title: AccessTokenData
AccessTokenData.description: The refresh token is never in the body; it is set as an httpOnly cookie.

EvaluateWritingRequest.title: EvaluateWritingRequest
EvaluateWritingRequest.description: The target kanji is loaded from the KanjiPractice row, not taken from the client.

PracticeRef.title: PracticeRef
PracticeRef.description: A practice item inside a lesson; fetch its content from the skill's own endpoint.

SubmitDialogueAttemptRequest.title: SubmitDialogueAttemptRequest
SubmitDialogueAttemptRequest.description: The learner's transcripts per exchange; the server rates them and awards XP.

VocabQueueResponse.title: VocabQueueResponse
VocabQueueResponse.description: Due cards for today's SRS review session.
